subject.title: feat: show live session activity for running tasks

question: Should OpenClaw accept this public `sessions.activity`/`session.activity` and plugin-hook contract now, or should the PR be narrowed behind the canonical session activity design?
rationale: The branch creates durable Gateway and plugin SDK contracts, and the canonical activity issue still leaves attention state, stale-run behavior, child rollups, and API shape as maintainer-owned product decisions.

options.title: Repair And Align Contract
options.body: Fix the scoping bug, refresh against current main, and only keep the public RPC/event/hooks that match the maintainer-approved activity contract.

options.title: Narrow To UI Task Ledger
options.body: Drop the plugin hooks and broad activity API for now, then integrate only the useful running-work UI behavior with current `tasks.list` and `task` events.

options.title: Pause Behind Canonical Design
options.body: Keep or close the PR as pending product direction until the canonical session activity issue defines the permanent contract.

recommendation.title: Repair And Align Contract
recommendation.body: Fix the scoping bug, refresh against current main, and only keep the public RPC/event/hooks that match the maintainer-approved activity contract.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc is assigned to the canonical session activity issue and has recent Gateway/protocol-adjacent history.
